name: San Francisco Poker
description: San Francisco: 7-card stud variant where all Queens are wild. Same deal and betting as 7-card stud; any Queen counts as any card. USA; dealer's choice.

overview.description: San Francisco: 7-card stud variant where all Queens are wild. Same deal and betting as 7-card stud; any Queen counts as any card. USA; dealer's choice.

history.origins: American 7-card stud variant; Queens wild. Popular in home and dealer's choice games.
timeline: Present: Played in wild-card and mixed games

setup.players: From two to eight players may take part. The game is best for five to seven players; with eight players the deck can run short on the final deal. All four Queens are wild for every player.
setup.dealing: Same as 7-card stud. All Queens are wild for all players.

rules.objective: Make the best five-card poker hand from seven cards; all Queens are wild.
rules.gameplay: Betting as in 7-card stud. At showdown, any Queen substitutes for any card; use any five of seven for best hand.
keyRules: All Queens are wild for everyone

strategy.basic: Four Queens in deck make straights and flushes more common; play for big hands.
strategy.intermediate: Track exposed Queens; fewer Queens out means your hand is less likely to be outdrawn.
strategy.advanced: Variant-specific bluffing when Queens are showing.

variations.name: Standard (Queens wild)
variations.description: Sources describe only the standard form; all four Queens are wild for all players. Same deal and betting as 7-card stud.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: No engine overrides; variation is rule-level only.
